name: Earnings Beat vs Miss: 30-Day Forward Returns
description: Compares 30-day forward returns after earnings beats (EPS Surprise % > 0) vs misses (EPS Surprise % <= 0) for AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, and GOOGL. Includes distribution boxplots, average return comparison bars, detailed summary statistics, and event markers on each earnings date.
source:
# --- Earnings Beat vs Miss: 30-Day Forward Returns ---
# Classifies each earnings event as Beat (EPS Surprise % > 0) or Miss (<= 0),
# then measures the subsequent 30-day return distribution per stock.

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
earn = earnings()

# Forward 30-day return at every bar (raw decimal)
fwd_30d = forward_returns(src.c, 30, return_type=ReturnsType.simple)

# --- Classification ---
# Earnings dates have non-null eps_surprise_percent
has_earnings = is_valid(earn.eps_surprise_percent)
is_beat = earn.eps_surprise_percent > 0
is_miss = has_earnings and not is_beat

# Beat/Miss label as string for event markers
outcome_label = conditional_select(is_beat, "Beat", is_miss, "Miss", "")

# --- Filtered forward returns by outcome ---
beat_fwd = where(is_beat, fwd_30d)
miss_fwd = where(is_miss, fwd_30d)

# --- Hit rates: % of events with positive forward return ---
# Mean of boolean (1/0) filtered to event bars = hit rate
beat_hit_rate = agg(where(is_beat, fwd_30d > 0), AggregationType.Mean)
miss_hit_rate = agg(where(is_miss, fwd_30d > 0), AggregationType.Mean)

# Total event counts (expanding)
beat_total_count = agg(beat_fwd, AggregationType.Count)
miss_total_count = agg(miss_fwd, AggregationType.Count)

# --- CHART 1: Boxplot — Distribution of 30d returns by Beat vs Miss ---
cs_boxplot(
    mode=CSBoxplotMode.multi_metric,
    title="Do Earnings Beats Lead to Better 30-Day Returns?",
    metric_names=["Beat", "Miss"],
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_label="30-Day Forward Return",
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    category="Earnings Analysis",
    order=1
)(values=(beat_fwd, miss_fwd))

# --- CHART 2: Bar chart — Avg 30d return by Beat vs Miss per stock ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.grouped,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title="Average 30-Day Return: Beats vs Misses",
    series_names=["Beat", "Miss"],
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Gray],
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label="Avg 30-Day Forward Return",
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    category="Earnings Analysis",
    order=2
)(values=(beat_fwd, miss_fwd))

# --- TABLE: Summary statistics per stock ---
cs_summary_table(
    title="Earnings Outcome Statistics",
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    category="Earnings Analysis",
    order=3,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Earnings Outcome Statistics",
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Beat Avg 30d Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Beat Med 30d Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Median),
            ColumnSpec(title="Beat Hit Rate", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(title="# Beats", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(title="Miss Avg 30d Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Miss Med 30d Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Median),
            ColumnSpec(title="Miss Hit Rate", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Last),
            ColumnSpec(title="# Misses", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Last)
        ]
    )
)(beat_fwd, beat_fwd, beat_hit_rate, beat_total_count, miss_fwd, miss_fwd, miss_hit_rate, miss_total_count)

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Each earnings date ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Earnings Event",
        icon=Icon.BarChart2Icon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Outcome", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="EPS Surprise %", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Actual EPS", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title="Estimated EPS", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title="30d Fwd Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(outcome_label, earn.eps_surprise_percent, earn.actual_eps, earn.estimated_eps, fwd_30d, has_earnings)
